description.en: Given two statements, decide which conclusion logically follows. Covers All-Some, All-No, and Some-No syllogism patterns.
description.as: দুটা উক্তি দিয়া থাকে; কোন সিদ্ধান্ত যুক্তিযুক্তভাৱে আহে নির্ণয় কৰক। All-Some, All-No আৰু Some-No আৰ্হি সামৰি লোৱা হৈছে।

q.en: Statements: All cats are animals. All animals are living beings. Conclusions: I. All cats are living beings. II. All living beings are cats.
q.as: উক্তি: All cats are animals. All animals are living beings. সিদ্ধান্ত: I. All cats are living beings. II. All living beings are cats.

explanation.en: Correct option A (Only I follows). All cats are animals and all animals are living beings, so all cats are living beings (I follows). II reverses the relation and does not follow.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (কেৱল I আহে)। All cats are animals আৰু All animals are living beings, গতিকে all cats are living beings (I আহে)। II য়ে সম্পৰ্ক ওলোটা কৰিছে, সেয়ে নাহে।

q.en: Statements: All apples are fruits. Some fruits are sweet. Conclusions: I. Some apples are sweet. II. Some fruits are apples.
q.as: উক্তি: All apples are fruits. Some fruits are sweet. সিদ্ধান্ত: I. Some apples are sweet. II. Some fruits are apples.

explanation.en: Correct option B (Only II follows). 'All apples are fruits' implies 'some fruits are apples' (II follows). 'Some fruits are sweet' does not prove that some apples are sweet (I does not follow).
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ B (কেৱল II আহে)। 'All apples are fruits' ৰ পৰা 'some fruits are apples' পোৱা যায় (II আহে)। 'Some fruits are sweet' ৰ পৰা some apples are sweet প্ৰমাণ নহয় (I নাহে)।

q.en: Statements: All students are hardworking. No hardworking person is lazy. Conclusions: I. No student is lazy. II. All hardworking people are students.
q.as: উক্তি: All students are hardworking. No hardworking person is lazy. সিদ্ধান্ত: I. No student is lazy. II. All hardworking people are students.

explanation.en: Correct option A (Only I follows). All students are hardworking and no hardworking person is lazy, so no student is lazy (I follows). II is the reverse and does not follow.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (কেৱল I আহে)। All students are hardworking আৰু no hardworking person is lazy, গতিকে no student is lazy (I আহে)। II ওলোটা, সেয়ে নাহে।

q.en: Statements: Some boys are intelligent. All intelligent people are clever. Conclusions: I. Some boys are clever. II. All clever people are boys.
q.as: উক্তি: Some boys are intelligent. All intelligent people are clever. সিদ্ধান্ত: I. Some boys are clever. II. All clever people are boys.

explanation.en: Correct option A (Only I follows). Those boys who are intelligent are also clever, so some boys are clever (I follows). That all clever people are boys is not certain (II does not follow).
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (কেৱল I আহে)। যিবোৰ ল'ৰা intelligent সেইবোৰ cleverও, গতিকে some boys are clever (I আহে)। All clever are boys নিশ্চিত নহয় (II নাহে)।

q.en: Statements: All birds have wings. Some birds are parrots. Conclusions: I. Some parrots have wings. II. All parrots are birds.
q.as: উক্তি: All birds have wings. Some birds are parrots. সিদ্ধান্ত: I. Some parrots have wings. II. All parrots are birds.

explanation.en: Correct option A (Only I follows). Some birds are parrots and all birds have wings, so those parrots have wings; hence some parrots have wings (I follows). II does not follow.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (কেৱল I আহে)। Some birds are parrots আৰু all birds have wings, গতিকে সেই parrotবোৰৰ wings আছে; সেয়ে some parrots have wings (I আহে)। II নাহে।

q.en: Statements: Some pens are pencils. No pencil is an eraser. Conclusions: I. Some pens are not erasers. II. No pen is an eraser.
q.as: উক্তি: Some pens are pencils. No pencil is an eraser. সিদ্ধান্ত: I. Some pens are not erasers. II. No pen is an eraser.

explanation.en: Correct option A (Only I follows). The pens that are pencils cannot be erasers, so some pens are not erasers (I follows). 'No pen is an eraser' is too broad (II does not follow).
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (কেৱল I আহে)। যিবোৰ pen, pencil সেইবোৰ eraser নহয়, গতিকে some pens are not erasers (I আহে)। 'No pen is an eraser' অতি ব্যাপক (II নাহে)।

q.en: Statements: All rings are circles. Some squares are circles. Conclusions: I. Some rings are squares. II. Some circles are squares.
q.as: উক্তি: All rings are circles. Some squares are circles. সিদ্ধান্ত: I. Some rings are squares. II. Some circles are squares.

explanation.en: Correct option B (Only II follows). 'Some squares are circles' converts to 'some circles are squares' (II follows). I does not follow because the two sets need not overlap.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ B (কেৱল II আহে)। 'Some squares are circles' লৈ 'some circles are squares' হয় (II আহে)। দুয়োটা সংহতিৰ মিল নিশ্চিত নহয় (I নাহে)।

explanation.en: Correct option B (Only II follows). 'All apples are fruits' means some fruits are apples (II follows). 'No mango is an apple' does not make a mango a non-fruit (I does not follow).
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ B (কেৱল II আহে)। 'All apples are fruits' ৰ পৰা some fruits are apples পোৱা যায় (II আহে)। 'No mango is an apple' ৰ পৰা mango fruit নহয় বুলি নহয় (I নাহে)।
